title: Dolphin
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='water' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#1a3a5c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#0d1f33'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='52' rx='30' ry='16' fill='#4da6e0'/>
  <!-- lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='58' rx='22' ry='10' fill='#a8d8f0'/>
  <!-- dorsal fin -->
  <path d='M42 36 Q48 22 56 36 Z' fill='#3a8cc4'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M18 52 Q8 38 4 42 Q10 52 4 62 Q8 66 18 52 Z' fill='#3a8cc4'/>
  <!-- tail fin top -->
  <path d='M10 44 Q2 30 6 28 Q12 36 14 42 Z' fill='#5ab8e8'/>
  <!-- tail fin bottom -->
  <path d='M10 60 Q2 74 6 76 Q12 68 14 62 Z' fill='#5ab8e8'/>
  <!-- pectoral fin -->
  <path d='M52 56 Q48 70 40 68 Q46 60 50 56 Z' fill='#3a8cc4'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='48' r='4' fill='#1a3a5c'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='47' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- eye highlight -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='49' r='0.8' fill='#a8d8f0'/>
  <!-- smile / beak line -->
  <path d='M72 52 Q78 54 80 52' stroke='#2a6a9a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- beak top -->
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='50' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#5ab8e8'/>
  <!-- beak tip -->
  <ellipse cx='85' cy='50' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#7acaf5'/>
  <!-- water spout -->
  <path d='M50 36 Q52 28 48 22' stroke='#7acaf5' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 36 Q58 26 54 20' stroke='#7acaf5' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- spout drops -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='20' r='2' fill='#a8d8f0'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='18' r='2' fill='#a8d8f0'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='23' r='1.5' fill='#cceeff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='21' r='1.5' fill='#cceeff'/>
  <!-- bubbles -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='40' r='2' fill='#55ccee' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='34' r='1.5' fill='#55ccee' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='30' r='1.2' fill='#55ccee' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
